description: Fill table cells from a 2-D array. Tables are numbered across the text frames of the page; cells outside the table are skipped and counted.

data.description: Rows of cell values; null becomes an empty cell

pageIndex.description: Page index (0-based); defaults to the active page

tableIndex.description: Index among the tables in page.textFrames, counted frame by frame

name: populate_table
title: Populate Table
